summary: Stage 5 GiftMoney, versioned exchange rules, transparent previews and atomic bidirectional Money/Coin exchange passed H2 and PostgreSQL 16.15 gates.

environment.containerLifecycle: isolated localhost-only test container was stopped and removed after validation

commands.result: H2 PostgreSQL-mode full regression passed with Flyway V1-V4.

commands.command: start isolated PostgreSQL 16 container; set test datasource environment; mvn -q -pl family-growth-boot -am test
commands.result: PostgreSQL 16.15 full suite passed; schema validation found four successful migrations and 17 production tables.

acceptance.AC5-01: PASS - gift deposit replay returned the original result and produced one business record.
acceptance.AC5-02: PASS - fixed bidirectional rate vectors and amount precision tests passed.
acceptance.AC5-03: PASS - preview snapshots expose source, rate, fee rate, fee, net source, target and education notice.
acceptance.AC5-04: PASS - child configuration, stale rules, insufficient balances and idempotency-key misuse were rejected without wallet side effects.
